items.long_description:
Audiolizer is an AI-powered tool designed to transform academic research papers into audio files, promoting a more convenient and accessible educational experience.

The tool utilizes advanced AI algorithms to analyze, interpret, and effectively elucidate the content of the papers, while highlighting key points, data, and contextual details such as mathematical formulas and illustrative tables.

This way, Audiolizer transcends the basic text-to-speech functionalities and provides a profound understanding of the academic content. Users can either input a link or upload a document file, and the tool converts the input into a seamless audio experience which combines technical accuracy with engaging narration.

Audiolizer also offers a free plan that allows users to convert and listen to a limited number of papers for free, providing an opportunity for users to explore its features.

Moreover, it ensures organization by storing all converted papers into one gallery for easy access at any time. In case of attention lapses or incomprehension during listening, users have the option to access a written interpretation of the narration.
